_comment: Canonical MCP source of truth. build-adapters.py rewraps this into .mcp.json (Claude, key mcpServers), .vscode/mcp.json (VS Code, key servers), and .github/mcp.json (Copilot CLI/JetBrains workspace, key mcpServers). Coding agent: paste the mcpServers object into repo Settings > Copilot > Coding agent.

obsidian-vault._note: Obsidian Local REST API plugin (v4+ serves MCP). HTTPS variant on :27124 with the plugin's self-signed cert. File-access fallback: hooks read/write the vault checkout directly when the API is down.
